war_summary: War 139, day 125, conquest active with 32 victory towns required and no winner. The map is sharply split: Colonials hold full or dominant control in AcrithiaHex, AllodsBightHex, AshFieldsHex, DeadLandsHex, DrownedValeHex, and others, while Wardens control BasinSionnachHex, ClansheadValleyHex, HowlCountyHex, ReachingTrailHex, StlicanShelfHex, and ViperPitHex. The heaviest combat and strategic-base volatility is concentrated in CallahansPassageHex, ClahstraHex, EndlessShoreHex, SpeakingWoodsHex, OnyxHex, and OarbreakerHex, where casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating and bases are actively flipping or going neutral. MarbanHollow, MooringCountyHex, GodcroftsHex, and StemaLandingHex also show recent ownership events but with somewhat lower intensity, while large swaths of the front remain stable with minimal activity, indicating that the next 24 hours of strategic-base changes will likely be localized to these high-activity contested corridors.
